title: Realtime view selector
description: Selects which projections a realtime stream or delta sync observes. Unknown fields are rejected by the server. Omitted fields mean false, an empty string, or zero.

catalog.description: Watch the public catalog page selected by query/offset (page size is fixed at 30).

query.description: Catalog search text; also applied when view.catalog is true.

subscription_detail.description: Playlist ID whose read-only detail (external view) should be watched.

subscription_limit.description: Detail page size; 0 selects the server default (50).

invitation_id.description: When set, the invitations section contains only this invitation (if visible).

owner_playlist.description: Owned playlist whose sharing state (invitations) should be watched.

public_detail.description: Public playlist whose detail page should be watched.

public_limit.description: Detail page size; 0 selects the server default (50).
